texts.facts: The present Writ Petition has been filed for issuance Mandamus, to direct the second respondent to permit the petitioner open the shop based on the representation dated 01.07.2025. 2. It is seen from the said order that this is the third occurr 4. Since the petitioner is running a petty shop, that area, he is not in a position to pay a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-. texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit petitioner is running a small shop (Petti kadai) in Alangudi, Arasa near bus stop and selling food items like, Chikki, Chocolates, Bisc Cigarettes etc. However, the respondents have initiated action agai the petitioner for selling Tobacco products in his shop. According petitioner, this is a second occurrence and he has already paid pen the first time. 3. The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing respondents would submit that this is third occurrence and that is reason, the second respondent has imposed a penalty of Rs.1,00,000/ (Rupees one lakh only) on the petitioner.
